clips.prompt: The young woman stands on the beach at golden hour, the wind in her long dark hair and coat; she notices the small seashell lying completely still on the wet sand to the left of her, walks a few slow barefoot steps to the left towards it and stops right next to it, looking down at it. The seashell does not move. Natural continuous movement, steady camera, sound of wind and surf.

She bends down and picks up the small seashell, which lies still on the sand, in one smooth movement, straightens up and looks at it in her hands. Calm continuous movement, steady camera, sound of waves.

Holding the small seashell, she takes a few slow steps to the right along the beach while lifting it to her ear, then stops and closes her eyes, listening. Calm, continuous movement, steady camera, wind and surf.

Close-up: with the seashell at her ear and her eyes closed she listens, then opens her eyes, smiles, lowers the small shell to her chest and looks out over the sea, the wind in her hair. Calm, gentle movement, the surf in the background.
